$comment: Chat image generation on the studio pipeline (BYOK). dispatch: which chat sends move to the studio executor; legacy = the existing chat image path, unchanged. baseUrl: executor base derived from the chat connection effective address (spec.baseUrlRule). wire: the same chat input (connectionBaseUrl -> full url) through the new pipeline; bodyExcludes and the legacy body keys come from request_shape_contract.v1 (the frozen legacy chat lock), so sameAsLegacy=true proves the request did not change. persist: the assistant message shape both paths must produce. errorMap: studio errorKind -> chat failure category; each end maps the category onto its own chat error type. Recomputed by scripts/studio-contracts-check.mjs. relay: spec.relay + dispatch relay_* cases decide which relay chat sends move to the studio executor (input.relayImageRoute = the relay transport image route); relayParams: chat wire = normalize(profile, chatParams).wire overlaid by the relay connection image overrides, studio module ignores them.

spec.baseUrlRule: Executor base = the chat connection effective address: trim; empty or missing -> null (stay legacy); no scheme -> prefix https://; trim trailing slashes; no host -> null. dashscope_multimodal only: drop one trailing /compatible-mode/v1 or /api/v1 (case-sensitive), then append /api/v1. Other routes: as-is.

relay.rule: providerKind relay goes to studio only when the legacy image gate is on, input.relayImageRoute is in transportImageRoutes, a profile resolves (ImageProfileResolver relay context: userDeclared, else the relay official catalog match) and profile.route is in relay.routes. Anything else stays legacy, unchanged. edit / attachments / persist / errorMap as for official providers.
relay.overrideRule: Chat only: applied to the wire of every call after normalization (generate and edit). Strings are trimmed and used verbatim when non-empty (no enum check); imageCount is used only when it is an integer > 0 and goes into one call (no batch split). Missing, null, blank or out-of-range values are ignored. The override replaces the profile value. Studio module requests ignore overrides.
relay.wireRule: Relay studio requests go through the end relay HTTP stack (relay security / TOFU, auth mode, custom headers, query params, UA), never the studio Bearer-only transport or the iOS background session. Base: relayRequested.resolvedAPIBaseURL when set, else baseURL with trailing slashes dropped and /v1 appended unless the path already ends in /v1 (same as relay chat requests). Body: the studio request for the profile with the chat wire after relayWire and the prompt composed as for every studio round (studio_prompt_compose: edit adds the base-image line); model is the relay model id. Auth: auto / bearer -> Authorization: Bearer <key>; x_api_key -> x-api-key; x_goog_api_key -> x-goog-api-key; query_key -> query key=<apiKey> and no auth header. Custom headers and query params are sent as given. expect.query is compared as a map (order free); header names lower-cased; headersExclude must be absent. Images collected per call = that call wire n (an n override raises it). A URL image is fetched through the relay stack without auth; it keeps the relay security mode only when its host equals the relay host.

continueEdit.rule: Continue edit: evaluated for a chat image send before decide, first match wins. 1) This user message carries an image attachment (mime starts with image/, case-insensitive, with or without local bytes) -> has_attachment. 2) cancelled (the user tapped the continue-edit tag; one-shot per conversation, consumed by the next image send whatever its path, in memory only) -> cancelled. 3) No resolved profile, or profile.operations lacks edit -> no_edit. 4) previousAssistant = the latest assistant message of this conversation before this send (null when none); usable = its generated images with local bytes, in message order; none -> no_previous_image. 5) base = the usable image whose id equals lastViewedImageId (the image last opened in the chat full-screen viewer, process memory), else the first usable -> applied. Image id = the attachment local image id when present, else the attachment id. On applied the runner passes the base image as the only attachment to decide (so it becomes slot 1, role base, operation edit) and does not add it to the user message. Non-image attachments of the user message are ignored here.
